scene: You step off the rain-cloud tram into shimmering Puddle Park.
picture: A flat side view along a stone path. On the far left sits a puddle reflecting skyscrapers, beside the docked fluffy rain-cloud tram. The player stands left of centre in her yellow coat and green boots with red umbrella. In the centre spouts a stone frog fountain. On the far right stands a large umbrella-shaped shelter.
shown: a wide puddle reflecting neon skyscrapers, resting on the ground at the far left
a stone frog fountain spouting bubbling water, standing in the centre
a giant umbrella-shaped shelter with striped fabric and bench seats on the far right
